title: Sports Champions
subtitle: A new motion controller needs something to demonstrate
summary: Sports Champions is San Diego Studio and Zindagi Games' PlayStation 3 sports collection, first released in Europe on 15 September 2010. It introduces the PlayStation Move through six activities that connect the player's physical gestures to equipment on screen. Disc golf and bocce sit beside more immediately familiar sporting ideas, giving the controller several different movements to recognise. The collection asks the player to learn the feel of each activity rather than a large command list. A throw, swing or guarded movement becomes useful because the accessory can track how it is being performed.
body: Sports Champions is San Diego Studio and Zindagi Games' PlayStation 3 sports collection, first released in Europe on 15 September 2010. It introduces the PlayStation Move through six activities that connect the player's physical gestures to equipment on screen. Disc golf and bocce sit beside more immediately familiar sporting ideas, giving the controller several different movements to recognise. The collection asks the player to learn the feel of each activity rather than a large command list. A throw, swing or guarded movement becomes useful because the accessory can track how it is being performed.

Each activity gives the Move a different physical role, encouraging the player to adjust the timing and direction of a familiar hand-held object. Free Play offers practice, Challenge mode pursues higher scores and Champion Cup supplies a progression through opponents. A roster of athletes stands in for the player, while multiplayer allows the activities to become a shared competition. The collection's variety matters because it makes differences in movement practical. An action learned for one event cannot simply be repeated unchanged in another, even though the same controller remains in the hand.

The game was presented at the 2010 Game Developers Conference and bundled with PlayStation Move in several regions. Sean Levantino and Greg Wondra contributed to the design for a production shared between Sony's San Diego team and Zindagi Games. Its release gave the hardware a clear introductory role, demonstrating several kinds of motion input in short activities that another person could quickly attempt. Sports Champions belongs to the history of console peripherals as much as sports games, because its purpose is to make the new controller's tracking understandable through the action of playing.
